title: Lifeblood Anchors
description: The Lifeblood of hollownest in here
body:
# 🩸 Lifeblood Anchors

Bind your vitality to the deep blue glow. Inspired by the hidden mysteries of *Hollow Knight*, **Lifeblood Anchors** introduces a high-risk, high-reward health management system centered around ancient, pulsing monoliths.

Instead of relying on fleeting cocoons, you can now construct and charge permanent hubs of Lifeblood energy to fortify yourself against the darkest threats in your world.

---

> ### 🛑 Dimensional Warning
> 
> 
> Just like vanilla respawn anchors carry volatile energy, forcing a Lifeblood Anchor to manifest in unstable, non-organic dimensions (like the End or certain custom realms) might lead to a catastrophic, explosive discharge. Use with caution!
